name: Forest Path to the Grove
player_description: The path is not on any Roman map. It exists because feet have used it for a very long time. The trees here are old — older than the fort, older than the Roman presence, possibly older than anyone's accounting. The light changes about a mile in. It is not darker, exactly. It is more present.
gm_notes: Session 3. Skill check menu from locations.qmd: DC 12 Survival (Titus Half-Germanic guides, auto-success with him present). DC 14 Nature: three medicinal herbs at path edge — Valeria wants these. DC 13 Perception: something is following the party, staying just off the path. It is a Vaettir — territorial, not hostile unless the party leaves the path. DC 16 Religion: rune markers on specific trees mark the boundary of the grove's influence. The markers get closer together as the party approaches. The grove is aware of the party before the party reaches it. One specific tree has a fresh cut that is not weather damage — someone marked it recently, within a week.
